text: Oi. Nobody crosses Gruk's bridge for free.
I haven't got any coins. Can I pay some other way?
Riddle, then. What has a mouth but never speaks, and a bed but never sleeps?
Hmph. Lucky guess. Go on, then.
What can fill a room but takes up no space?
Bah. Somebody told you that one.
Gruk could do this all day.
